problem_restatement.input: The liquid SP500 and SPCX HIP-3 markets have exact local depth, trade, mark, funding, fee, and qualification evidence, but prior pressure-transfer and opening-range momentum mechanisms failed.
problem_restatement.output: A causal development-only falsification of a materially distinct cash-open overreaction reversal mechanism.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: Development and every technical path satisfy the frozen checks without reading validation or holdout economics.
problem_restatement.stakeholder_boundary: No strategy, asset, route, risk, sizing, execution, process, or live configuration change is authorized.

hypothesis: A cash-open gap of at least 20 bps in SP500 or SPCX may overreact during the first completed 15-minute bar and partially reverse toward the prior eligible cash-session close before the current cash close, after exact HIP-3 costs.

primary_research_basis.title: Intraday price reversals in the US stock index futures market: A 15-year study
primary_research_basis.predeclared_translation: Use the paper's reported 20-bps opening filter. Wait beyond its documented first-ten-minute continuation by deciding after the first completed 15-minute bar. Treat its cost caveat as a mandatory exact-cost falsifier.

primary_research_basis.title: Intraday price reversals for index futures in the US and Hong Kong
primary_research_basis.predeclared_translation: Test both positive and negative opening gaps and keep the magnitude threshold fixed rather than PnL-tuning it.

frozen_contract.event_definition: absolute cash-open gap from prior eligible 16:00 close is at least the fixed threshold
frozen_contract.entry_time: first exact next-bar quote after the completed 09:30-09:45 bar

execution_contract.entry_and_market_exit: exact next-bar L2 bid or ask
execution_contract.risk_path: exact mark extrema with post-entry entry-bar slicing
execution_contract.fees: current exact account and HIP-3 venue fee inputs
execution_contract.scaled_depth: per-symbol p99 visible-cost tail at $5000 notional
execution_contract.unresolved_path_policy: fail technical disposition without numerical filling

alternatives_considered: Restore the failed HIP-3 pressure route: rejected because it is not a distinct mechanism and its live evidence was concentrated and adverse.
Retune the rejected opening-range breakout: rejected because that development result failed stress and largest-winner sensitivity and its OOS remains sealed.
VWAP pullback trend continuation: deferred because the retrieved primary evidence did not establish a precise modern S&P futures rule and non-primary sources would make parameter selection arbitrary.
Do nothing beyond v53 observation: remains the baseline and wins if this development result fails any frozen check.
uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The cited S&P futures evidence is from 1987-2002 and may not transfer to a 2026 HIP-3 perpetual market.
The strongest 15-year paper reports that bid-ask costs sharply reduce significance.
SPCX is a different underlying and has much higher visible execution cost than SP500.
A roughly two-month archive may produce too few independent event days for stable inference.
Large cash-open gaps may be information-driven continuation rather than temporary overreaction in the current regime.
Exact mark and L2 outages can leave selected lifecycle paths technically unresolved.
falsifier: Reject in development if either symbol has nonpositive stress economics, PF at or below one, negative stress net after removing its largest winner, one-sided evidence, fewer than two positive stress folds, any liquidation, or unresolved selected lifecycle paths. Do not inspect validation or holdout economics after rejection.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Run the exact development-only SP500 and SPCX cash-open gap-reversal replay while the first attributable v53 live lifecycle watcher remains armed.
